tools.name: digest-antigravity
tools.description: Ingest many files at once and answer a focused question. Uses Antigravity's large model context (Gemini ~1M tokens) to swallow whole modules / docs that don't fit in the caller's context. Walks directories (symlinks are not followed), filters by extension, withholds credential files (.env, .npmrc, keys…), truncates oversized files, caps total payload. Returns a concentrated brief.

question.description: Focused question to answer using the provided files (e.g., "explain auth flow", "find dead code").

paths.description: Files or directories to ingest, inside workingDir (symlinks are resolved; anything outside is skipped). Directories are walked. Globs are NOT expanded — pass concrete paths.

extensions.description: Filter by extensions when walking dirs (e.g., [".ts", ".tsx"]). Default: all text-like files.

exclude.description: Substrings to exclude from paths (matched against relative path). Default: node_modules, .git, dist, build.

maxBytesPerFile.description: Truncate any single file above this size. Default: 200 KB.

maxTotalBytes.description: Stop adding files once the total payload exceeds this. Gemini models have ~1M-token contexts; 8 MB default leaves headroom.

shape.description: summary: 1-paragraph; detailed: structured deep-dive; qa: focused answer to the question.

effort.description: Reasoning effort (--effort). Supported levels depend on the model — see list-models. Use with a base model ID (e.g. gemini-4-hydrogen); not supported by Orchestrator.

tools.name: delegate-antigravity
tools.description: Delegate a long, multi-step implementation task to Antigravity. Runs detached in its own git worktree/branch, by default on the Orchestrator model (planner + Gemini 4 Hydrogen implementer, built for long tasks). Returns a taskId immediately; poll `status` for live progress, `continue` to send follow-up instructions into the same conversation, and `result` for the final answer + diff. The worktree isolates git state only — with skipPermissions (default) the agent can run any command.

action.description: start: spawn a delegated task; status: live progress; continue: send a follow-up turn to the same conversation; result (alias collect): final answer + diff; stop: kill the running turn; list: all delegations.

task.description: What Antigravity should accomplish (required for start).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bullet list of criteria the implementation must satisfy.

baseBranch.description: Branch/commit to base the worktree on (default: current HEAD of repo).

branchName.description: Name for the new branch in the worktree. Default: agy/<random>.

autoTest.description: Command the agent must run to verify its work (e.g. "npm test"); it is told to loop until it passes.

model.description: Model ID or label. Omit to use the Orchestrator (Carbon, else Argon) when your plan has one, otherwise Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High).

effort.description: --effort for non-Orchestrator models (Orchestrator has a fixed thinking level).

mode.description: Agent mode (--mode): accept-edits, auto (sandboxed autonomy; not available on every account), or plan (answers go into a plan artifact).

skipPermissions.description: --dangerously-skip-permissions (default true: a headless run cannot answer permission prompts; false when `mode` is set; not allowed with mode plan). The worktree isolates git state, NOT the filesystem — the agent can still read/write outside it and run any command.

sandbox.description: --sandbox: run terminal commands in the OS sandbox.

taskId.description: Delegation ID returned by start (any turn's task ID also works).

cleanup.description: On result/collect: also remove the worktree and delete the branch after grabbing the diff.

signal.description: Signal for action=stop (default SIGTERM; SIGKILL for a run that ignores it).
